skills.name: 爆栗出击
skills.description:
森海飞霞向目标单位发射一颗橡栗，可以弹射至附近敌人，减缓他们的移动速度，并造成攻击伤害的一定百分比和额外伤害。
可以对地面施放，在目标地点种出一棵树，而橡栗会弹射至附近目标。设为自动施放后会强制沿用该行为。
skills.descriptionEn:
Fires Hoodwink's attack with an acorn at the target unit. The acorn bounces to nearby targets, slowing them and dealing a percentage of Hoodwink's attack with bonus damage.
If point targeted, a tree is created at the target position and the acorn will bounce to nearby targets. The ability may be placed on auto-cast to force this behavior.
skills.super: 超级: +2 爆栗出击弹射，+50% 基础伤害。
skills.gaben: G 胖: 提供+60 基础伤害，攻击在 7 秒内降低 10 的目标护甲。
skills.superEn: Super: +2 Acorn Shot bounces, +50% base damage.
skills.gabenEn: Gaben: Grants +60 base damage, attacks reduce target's armor by 10 for 7 seconds.

skills.description: 寒冬飞龙乘着一股极地寒风扶摇而上，移动将无视地形，每次攻击都将呼出逼人的寒气。高飞时，她的攻击射程更远，攻击弹道速度也更快，被攻击的敌人在寒意作用下，移动速度也被减缓，同时每秒损失6% / 7% / 8% / 9%当前生命值。在夜晚的寒风中，她的视野还会被加强，在技能期间夜晚将额外获得400的视野范围。

Gathers the hero's power into a bolt of scouring energy that, when released, damages, roots, and purges enemies of buffs in an area around the target. If target is an ally it will only purge debuffs.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

skills.superEn: Super: Applies Purifying Flames to all enemies and allies within the effect radius of the main target, dealing 360 magical damage. This applies before the dispel. Heals 44 health per second over 9 seconds.
skills.gabenEn: Gaben: Applies Rain of Destiny, centered on the main target. Heals/Damages allies/enemies for 60 health per second over 10 seconds. While inside Rain of Destiny, allies/enemies have their heal amplification increased/reduced by 25%.

catalogZh.description: 眩晕目标敌方英雄，然后造成基于他当前损失生命值的伤害。施法者击杀敌人后将永久获得生命和魔法恢复。此效果影响下的任意击杀都将被记入施法者击杀。
catalogZh.superUpgrade: 超级: +9 每次叠加生命值回复，+6 每次叠加魔法回复，+500 施法范围。如果目标在死神镰刀作用下死亡，那么施法者将恢复与当前生命值和法力值相等的生命值与法力值。
catalogZh.gabenUpgrade: G 胖: 100% 的死神镰刀伤害将在 400 范围内的所有敌人身上均分。

skills.name: 回身踢
skills.description:
玛西跃向友方目标单位，选好她要弹离的方向和距离。到达目标后玛西冲向最终的目的地，对区域内敌人造成伤害和眩晕。

友军将获得25% / 30% / 35% / 40%移动速度加成，持续5秒。
skills.descriptionEn:
Marci bounds to the targeted allied unit, choosing a direction and distance she will spring away from it. Upon reaching the unit, Marci lunges to her final destination, damaging and stunning enemies where she lands.

The ally receives 25% / 30% / 35% / 40% bonus movement speed for 5s.
skills.super: 超级: 为目标和施法者提供 2 秒的技能免疫。+1000 跳跃距离范围。
skills.gaben: G 胖: 被眩晕的敌方单位将被施加 4 级过肩摔。
skills.superEn: Super: Provides spell immunity to both target and caster for 2 seconds. +1000 Leap Distance range.
skills.gabenEn: Gaben: Enemy units stunned will have a level 4 Dispose cast on them.

catalog.name: Rebound

catalog.differences: AI: Targets closest ally and farthest enemy.
catalog.superUpgrade: Super: Provides spell immunity to both target and caster for 2 seconds. +1000 Leap Distance range.
catalog.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Enemy units stunned will have a level 4 Dispose cast on them.

skills.name: 共鸣脉冲
skills.description: 虚无之灵将自己包裹在保护性护盾之中，可以吸收物理伤害，并围绕自身发出一次伤害性的脉冲。脉冲每击中一个敌方英雄，护盾的伤害吸收效果都会提升。
skills.descriptionEn: Void Spirit wraps himself in a protective shield that absorbs physical damage and emits a single damaging pulse around him. The shield gains increased damage absorption for each enemy hero the pulse hits.
skills.super: 超级: 为每个被共鸣脉冲击中的单位提供 1 秒技能免疫。+100 伤害。
skills.gaben: G 胖: 现最多有 2 充能并会使被击中的敌人沉默 2 秒。
skills.superEn: Super: Grants 1s of spell immunity for each unit hit by Resonant Pulse. +100 damage.

skills.name: 巨石翻滚
skills.description: 大地之灵化身为巨石，经过0.5秒延迟后沿目标位置翻滚，对经过的敌人造成伤害和眩晕，伤害值为30 + 100%力量。如果撞到敌方英雄或自身被眩晕，翻滚都会中止。如果翻滚过程中经过残岩将会大幅提高翻滚距离和速度，造成的眩晕时间更长。
skills.descriptionEn: Earth Spirit gathers himself into a boulder and, after a 0.5s delay, rolls toward the target location, dealing 30 + 100% STR damage and stunning enemy units. He will stop if he collides with an enemy hero or is stunned. If he rolls over a Stone Remnant, he will travel further and faster, and stun enemies for longer.

skills.gaben: G 胖: 提供 80% 状态抗性并持续 2 秒。
skills.superEn: Super: Plus 150 + 100% STR damage, +1s stun.
skills.gabenEn: Gaben: Gives 80% Status Resist for 2 seconds.

skills.name: 滚雷
skills.description:
施法者卷成一个免疫法术的球并滚出。滚动时其速度将越来越快，并且可以穿过树木，但转弯能力下降。可使敌人被击退，同时在敌人落地时造成伤害并使其眩晕。 

施法者变化方向并与墙壁或悬崖碰撞时会引发暂时停顿。

驱散类型: 基础驱散。
skills.descriptionEn:
Caster curls into a spell-immune ball and rolls out. When rolling, he moves at an increased speed and can move through trees, but has a decreased ability to turn. Striking enemies knocks them back, inflicting damage and stunning them when they land. 

Colliding with walls or cliffs will cause a temporary pause while caster reverses in direction.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel.
skills.super: 超级: +3 秒持续时间，-25 冷却时间。
skills.gaben: G 胖: 移除施法前摇。每次击中墙壁或英雄时都会获得 +40 移动速度。
skills.superEn: Super: +3s duration, -25s CD.
skills.gabenEn: Gaben: Removed cast point. Every time you hit a wall or hero, you gain +40 movespeed.

skills.name: 月神之箭
skills.description: 以致命的精度发射远程箭头，使其击中的第一个敌方单位眩晕并受到伤害。眩晕持续时间范围从0.01到3.7 / 4.3 / 4.9 / 5.5秒，根据箭头到目标的距离增加最多180的额外伤害。立即击杀其所击中的首个非远古生物小兵。

The stun duration ranges from 0.01 to 3.7 / 4.3 / 4.9 / 5.5 seconds, with bonus damage up to 180 added, based on the distance the arrow travels to its target. Instantly kills the first non-ancient creep it hits.
skills.super: 超级: 月神之箭在击中时生成 300 伤害的群星风暴流星，砸向其附近 500 范围内的敌人。-2s 冷却时间。
